steps.content: When they opened their eyes again, the world was spinning.
With great effort, the three sisters pushed their impossibly heavy bodies up, sitting slowly until their minds could catch up and steady themselves.
Their surroundings came into focus: the familiar ceiling, the familiar counter, the familiar aroma of coffee filling the air.
However...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Wait... This place...?!
Leaning on each other for strength, the three sisters staggered toward the floor-to-ceiling window. A flood of blinding sunlight made them wince and raise their arms in defense.
As their eyes adjusted, they took in the view.
Everything—the people, the cityscape, the streets—looked precisely like the world they remembered. But it felt profoundly wrong.
Astonishment locked them in place, quickly smothered by a tide of dread. That same vertigo and pain, the terrible signature of the abyss, seized them once again without warning.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: How is this possible...? What happened?
Kisugi Rui rubbed her temples, then took a deep breath to calm herself.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We're still alive—for now, at least. A small mercy, all things considered.
Steadying her own nerves first, the eldest sister opened her arms to her younger siblings.
The two younger sisters rushed into her embrace in silence, throwing their arms around her and burying their faces in her chest.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We just need to think. Calmly. As long as we have each other, we can handle anything.
The magic of her words immediately soothed their panicked hearts.
Suddenly, Kisugi Ai rubbed her nose, her expression sharpening with an idea. She hurried toward the computer on the first floor.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: The computer...! I'll—I'll find out where we are!
Gathered beside the computer desk, the three sisters all wore grave, troubled expressions. Even Kisugi Ai, usually the most optimistic, found herself frowning deeply.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: According to the information we just found, we're in a place called <color=#fb9259>DisCity</color>. And our café is located in... "Eastside"?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Huh... And further west, there's a place called <color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color>. I feel like I've heard that name somewhere before...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: But the "why"... Why were we brought here?
No one had an answer.
In the heavy silence, Kisugi Ai clicked back to the homepage. Her fingers hovered over the keyboard, typing half-formed queries only to delete them, lost for a starting point.
At that moment, Kisugi Hitomi pointed to a link marked in red below the input field and gestures for her little sister to open it.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Here, try this one!
The link led to a news compilation page. A new browser window sprang open, dominated by the image of a gleaming, monumental structure flanked by a gray-haired man.
steps.female_content: The link led to a news compilation page. A new browser window sprang open, dominated by the image of a gleaming, monumental structure flanked by a gray-haired woman.

steps.content: "The Great Expo Successfully Held! Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control Led Sinners to Attend!"
"Humanity Will Triumph over Mania!"
"Black Rings and Sinners Can Be Artificially Created"
With each scroll, another strange term surfaced. Kisugi Ai began listing them, frantically opening new tabs to search for definitions.
Yet the more they investigated, the darker their faces grew. A chilling truth settled over them: this world was saturated with the recorded atrocities of beings called Sinners.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Let me get this straight... This world has a power called "Mania." It twists people into these... um... powered individuals called "Sinners"?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: And look at this part! "This power is inherently unstable. Exceeding a critical threshold may result in becoming a..." A Corruptor? What's that?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Something that has lost all control, I'd imagine...
Kisugi Rui pointed to an entry detailing the formation and threat of Black Rings.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: No consciousness... highly aggressive... drawn to living flesh... consumption...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: So these... these "Black Rings" are zones full of those things? My god... How do people live here?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: It seems the police here bear a tremendous responsibility for the safety of all humanity...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: If that's the case, maybe this power is why we're here? Or at least one of the reasons.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Yeah, after all, that's the core difference between this world and ours.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Ugh, I've had enough… I just want to go home now, Rui… I can't believe we actually got sent to another world, just like in an anime!
With a frustrated sigh, Kisugi Ai dropped her head onto the desk. As she did, her puffed-out cheek pressed a key, accidentally scrolling to a new headline.
Viral Sensation Otherland Angels Sells for Record Price! Exhibition Scheduled for Next Week!
"Which Is the True Painting Not from This World?!"
And the featured image of the article...
It was the exact painting that had fractured into pieces before their eyes!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Rui, look! It's our painting!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Our painting made it through! We have to get it back!
Kisugi Rui's fingers reached out and traced the familiar painting on the screen. With a firm nod, she confirmed her choice.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Yes. The piece of Otherland Angels... With all three of us here, we will reclaim them. We will find every piece... Find the way home.
